name: local-model-gateway-monorepo
description: Lightweight local AI workstation management for coordinating model access across local agents and LLM apps.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit:ci && npm run scan:public && npm run pack:dry-run
